title: Friendship formation
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names qualities of a good friend (honest, kind, respectful, obedient, God-fearing), says Proverbs 22:24-25 warns against friends who are easily angered, and gives ways to resist bad influence (say no, walk away, tell, choose other friends).

floor.prerequisite: Knows whom to trust for safety.
floor.question: Name one trusted person.

steps: Choose friends who help you do right.
contexts: a friend who asks you to copy in a test
a new pupil with no friends
a group that dares you to sneak out

board.do: Draw a checklist titled "a good friend".
Point at the empty first line.
board.say: What is one quality of a good friend?

board.do: Wait for the child to say honest, kind or respectful.

listen_for: Because he is popular and has nice things
misconceptions.ask: Which is the best reason to choose a friend?
misconceptions.repair: List qualities with the class before naming friends.

listen_for: Copy so that you keep your friend
misconceptions.ask: A friend asks you to copy answers in a test. What should you do?
misconceptions.repair: Practise a short polite refusal in pairs.

listen_for: Be friends with a person who has a quick temper
Stay with them so I can change them
misconceptions.ask: Your friends steal from the canteen and want you to join. What is wise?
misconceptions.repair: Read Proverbs 22:25: you may learn their ways. Practise walking away kindly.

checks.question: What does Proverbs 22:24-25 advise?
checks.answer: Do not make friends with a hot-tempered person

checks.question: A friend asks you to copy in a test. What do you do?
checks.answer: Say no and offer to help study
